## TemplateEngine.\_TELEGRAM\_REQUIRED\_ATTRS property

Required-attribute specification for Telegram Rich HTML tags.

**Signature:**

```typescript
static _TELEGRAM_REQUIRED_ATTRS: Record<string, string[] | {
        oneOf: string[][];
    }>;
```

## Remarks

Per-tag table mapping tag name to the attribute(s) it must have. Two shapes are supported: - `string[]` — every entry must be present - `{ oneOf: string[][] }` — at least one of the listed sets must be fully present (used for `<a>` which can be either a link or an anchor)

Tags not listed here have no required attributes.

## Example


```typescript
TemplateEngine._TELEGRAM_REQUIRED_ATTRS["a"]       // => { oneOf: [["href"], ["name"]] }
TemplateEngine._TELEGRAM_REQUIRED_ATTRS["tg-time"] // => ["unix"]  (format is optional, value-validated when present)
```
